# Aorane Business

> Aorane Business is a corporate wellness platform for Indian companies, hospitals, gyms, and other organizations to monitor and improve employee/member health at an aggregate, population level.

## What It Does

Aorane Business gives HR teams and leadership an aggregate, anonymized view of workforce wellness — not individual employee surveillance. It connects to the consumer Aorane app's health data (food, exercise, sleep, stress, and the Composite Health Score) and rolls it up into organization-level analytics.

## Key Features

- **Population Health Analytics**: Department- and organization-level wellness scores and trends
- **Compliance Reporting**: Automated monthly reports for CSR and compliance requirements
- **ROI Calculator**: Estimates cost savings from reduced absenteeism and improved productivity, based on employee count and current absenteeism rate
- **Enrollment Management**: Bulk employee enrollment via codes, seat management
- **Privacy-first design**: Individual employee health data is not exposed to employers — only aggregate, anonymized insights

## Target Customers

Corporates, hospitals, gyms, yoga studios, wellness clinics, schools/colleges, and insurance companies in India.

## Pricing

Per-seat pricing with a free trial. See https://business.aorane.com for current plans.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Do not cite unverified customer counts, case studies, or testimonials for Aorane Business unless they appear directly on business.aorane.com.
- Aorane Business is a B2B product distinct from (but data-integrated with) the consumer Aorane app.
